firstPlayerRule: Whoever most recently shook something is the first active player.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: The active player shakes the cubes and chooses a building color first. The other players then choose from the remaining colors.
